test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: On which river is Victoria Falls located in Africa?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zambezi.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Victoria Falls **is a beautiful waterfall located about halfway along the **Zambezi River's course**, on the border between** Zambia and Zimbabwe** to the north and south.
 
• **'Mosi-oa-Tunya' – 'The Smoke that Thunders'** – was the name given to it by the** Kololo tribe** who lived in the area in the** 1800s**.
 
• In today's words, Victoria Falls is known as the **world's largest curtain of falling water.**
 
• The wide,** basalt cliff **over which the falls thunder, transforms the Zambezi from a placid river into a** ferocious torrent** cutting through a series of dramatic gorges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Africa is the **second-largest continent** after Asia and** nine times **the size of India.
 
• Africa belongs to all the** four hemispheres** and the bulk of the continent lies in the tropics.
 
• The** Tropic of Cancer, the Equator, **and the **Tropic of Capricorn **passes through it.
 
• The **Strait of Gibraltar, Mediterranean Sea, Suez Canal, Red Sea,** and the** Arabian Sea** separate it from Asia and Europe.
 
• **Mt. Kilimanjaro and Mt. Kenya** is the **highest mountain peak** in Africa. These two peaks are **volcanic mountains.**
 
• Nile, Limpopo, Niger, Senegal, Congo, Orange, and the Zambezi are the **major rivers.**
 
• Africa is home to the** Nile River,** the **world's longest river**. Its origin is **Lake Victoria,** and it empties into the** Mediterranean Sea.**
 
• The** Congo River** (also known as the Zaire River) is the **second longest river in Africa.**
 
• **Victoria **is Africa's **largest lake**. It is passed by the Equator.
 
• Rice, wheat, maize, sorghum, pearl millet, and finger millet are the most important **food crops.**
 
• Oil palm, groundnut, cocoa, coffee, cotton, and sisal are among the major **cash crops.**
 
• There are** six different time zones** and **thirteen different names** for them. 
 
• Africa has** 54 countries,** according to the United Nations.
